notes: Setup warns before Google TV forgets its setup Wi-Fi and offers Reconnect Wi-Fi. The tidy-up knows common trackers on any brand (Samba TV, Anoki, Inscape, Alphonso and more), never touches the TV's inputs, and lets you keep any line. New: Optimize in Customize > About HomeZ, for preinstalled apps you don't use; a check that offers to switch things off again when a TV update turns them back on; and Keep voice search on Google TV. Safer phone page (PIN only in a header, 10 tries per PIN), sideload links to your home network are refused and a failed install can be retried. The phone page shows the TV's name and lets you undo a background change.
